svg.title: Side by side: Four-mode example, Eight-block example and Pilot dense map (fictional)
svg.desc: 3 platforms aligned by band: the 6 layers and the 3 bands as columns, one platform per row.

g.aria-label: Sources: Where does the data come from?
Ingestion: How does data get into the platform?
Storage: Where is it kept, and in what format?
Processing and transformation: What engine cleans, joins and prepares it?
Consumption: How does it reach dashboards, reports and apps?
Artificial intelligence: How are models and agents built on the data?
Governance and security: Who can see what, and how is it audited?
Operations and cost: How is it monitored, deployed and paid for?
Orchestration: Who decides what runs, and when?
Four-mode example: v0.1.0 · verified 6 days ago
Source systems: 1 component. Components: Admissions system.
Data intake: 2 components. Components: Relational database connector, Change capture.
Central store: 2 components. Components: Raw data zone, Clean tables in an open format.
Preparation: 2 components. Components: Transformation engine, Declarative pipelines.
Dashboards: 2 components. Components: Semantic model, Bed occupancy dashboard.
Agents: 1 component, public preview. Components: Data question agent.
Governance: 2 components. Components: Central catalog, Row filters and masking.
Usage monitor: 1 component. Components: Usage monitor.
Task scheduler: 1 component. Components: Task scheduler.

Pilot dense map (fictional): v1.0.0 · verified 6 days ago
Source systems: 2 components. Components: Operational databases, Files in other clouds.
Data intake: 2 components. Components: Continuous replica, Scheduled table copy.
Central store: 4 components. Components: Replicated database, Single lake, Open tables zone, SQL store.
Preparation: 2 components. Components: Notebooks and parallel engine, Visual dataflows v2.
Dashboards: 2 components. Components: Direct semantic model, Interactive reports.
Agents: 1 component. Components: Question agent.
Governance: 2 components. Components: Lake security, Sensitivity labels.
Operations and cost: 2 components. Components: Shared capacity, Usage metrics.
Orchestration: 2 components. Components: Scheduled pipelines, Directed task graphs.
